analysis: The code snippet contains two for-loops that iterate over maps using iterators. In each loop, the condition iter.hasNext() is checked before calling iter.next() in the loop body. The API method `next` throws NoSuchElementException if there are no more elements. Because `hasNext()` is called at the start of each iteration and returns true only when elements remain, the call to `next()` is guaranteed to succeed, thus avoiding the NoSuchElementException. No other exceptions are declared in the javadoc for `next`.
remark: The NoSuchElementException is avoided because each call to iter.next() is preceded by a check of iter.hasNext(), ensuring that the iterator has a next element before attempting to retrieve it.
